name: translateyourreviews
description: Web extension that provides translation for reviews on RateYourMusic
author: compscitwilight

scripts.build: npm run build:js && npm run build:assets
scripts.package: rm -f tyr.zip && cd dist && zip -r ../tyr.zip ./* && cd ..
scripts.package:source: rm -f source.zip && zip -r ./source.zip src/* package.json public/*
